==Overview==
The '''Section Executive Invasion Event''' was an event that started on 08/17/25 and ended on 09/20/25. The event was about encountering an invading entity from [[Section E]], them being [[E-10]] and [[E-60#Old|E-60]]. Successfully surviving one of them would have awarded the player with the [https://www.roblox.com/badges/3124983362195746/Sector-Breach Sector Breach] Badge, which gives them access to the '''Radiant Experimental Flashlight''', which is the Shakable version of the normal Experimental Flashlight.

==Trivia==
* Both [[E-10]] and [[E-60]] had a 1 in 2500 chance to spawn at the start of the event, the rarity was bought down as the event went on, the chances were:
** 1 in 2500 (Start of Event)
** 1 in 2000 (5 Days Left)
** 1 in 1750 (3 Days Left)
** 1 in 1600 (Last Day)
** 1 in 1500 (Final 4 Hours)
** 1 in 1350 (Final Hour)
** 1 in 690 (Final Minute)
* [[E-60]] got his design changed mid-event
